chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us, saying: Abu Ali Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Isma'il al-Yashkuri al-Marwazi narrated to us, saying: Sahl ibn 'Ammar al-Naysaburi narrated to us, saying: Umar ibn Abdullah ibn Razin narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated, from Sa'id ibn 'Amr ibn Ashwa', from al-Sha'bi, from Jabir ibn Samurah, who said:

I went with my father to the mosque while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was delivering a sermon. I heard him say: 'After me, there will be twelve, meaning leaders.' Then he lowered his voice, so I did not know what he said. I asked my father: 'What did he say?' He said: 'He said: They are all from Quraysh.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the number and lineage of his successors?
ai.summary: This narration from Jabir ibn Samurah, recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, establishes the foundational Hadith al-Thalatha ‘Ashar, confirming that the twelve successors will be from Quraysh, a criterion central to Shia Imamology. The detail of the Prophet lowering his voice suggests the names were either whispered to the crowd or kept secret until their emergence, emphasizing the divine selection of these leaders. This tradition serves as a primary textual proof for the succession of the Twelve Imams, linking prophetic authority directly to the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 12-14 Ahmad ibn al-Hassan al-Qat’tan narrated that Abu Ali Muhammad ibn Isma’il al-Yashkari al-Marvazy quoted Sahl ibn Ammar al-Neishaboory, on the authority of Umar ibn Abdullah ibn Razin, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Sa’id ibn Amr ibn Ashva’e, on the authority of Al-Sha’abi, on the authority of Jabir ibn Samurah,

“I went to the mosque with my father when the Prophet (MGB) was delivering a sermon. I heard the Prophet (MGB) say, ‘There will be twelve Leaders after me.’ Then the Prophet (MGB) lowered his voice such that I could not understand what he (MGB) said. I asked my father, ‘What did he (MGB) say when he lowered his voice?’ My father said, ‘The Prophet (MGB) said, ‘They are all from the Quraysh.’”
